digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and command discovery
propositions: Twenty-one visible pure-intercept routes support `rebar <command> --help` but remain absent from overview help and fail under `rebar help <command>`.
Identity child parsers disable their own help actions, causing `rebar identity create --help` to reach top-level usage and exit with an error.
The help-backed predicate must be exactly `not route.hidden and not route.retired` across four generator and test sites to make intercept routes discoverable.
Generated help artifacts and the CLI reference must be regenerated to commit route-specific usage and maintain byte parity across Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13.
Nested parser families must enable help fallthrough for child commands while preserving explicit handler-dispatched help like `config validate --help`.
Schema coverage and driver exemption metadata must be added for newly discoverable output advertisers to satisfy CI contract validation.
